Read and Answer.passage: Zara lives in a small town. Every morning, she waters the plants in her garden. One day, she saw a little bird sitting on the wall. The bird looked hungry. Zara put some seeds in a bowl and kept it near the wall. The bird ate the seeds and sang a happy song. Zara smiled. After that, the bird came every morning. Zara and the bird became good friends. Zara learned that small acts of kindness make others happy.

content.script: Pinky and Jojo had a cheeky crow in Taleemabad. The crow took things from the farmhouse and the square. Jojo said, "This isn't right!" Pinky said, "Let's teach it tonight." They read the crow a story with a storybook in hand. The crow listened and sighed. It returned what it took and tried to be kinder every day.
